Chaweng's nightlife runs on three tracks. Soi Green Mango holds the clubs, led by the Green Mango Club, open nightly from about 21:00 to 04:00 and busiest after midnight. The beach has ARKbar's free fire shows and DJs every night from 20:00 to 24:00, with pool parties listed for Wednesday and Friday afternoons. Then there are two Muay Thai stadiums with fights from about 21:00 six nights a week (none on Thursday). Saturday is the peak night, Friday a close second, and most nights out cost 1,000–2,500 THB per person before the ride home.

This page goes deeper than our island-wide Koh Samui nightlife guide: what each street and venue is like, which night to go, what things cost in Chaweng specifically, the tricks to avoid and how to get back to your bed at 03:00. Venue details were checked against 2026 sources at the start of November 2026; hours shift with the season, so treat them as a guide and check on the night.

Map of Chaweng nightlife

[kp_places_map]

Everything sits within about 2 km. Chaweng Beach Road runs parallel to the sand; Soi Green Mango and Soi Solo cut between the road and the beach in the central stretch, and the two stadiums are a short ride inland towards Chaweng Lake. Quick directions: Soi Green Mango · ARKbar · Phetchbuncha Stadium · Samui International Muay Thai Stadium · Central Samui and Chaweng Lake.

Soi Green Mango

Soi Green Mango is the short lane that turns off Chaweng Beach Road towards the sea, lined with clubs, bars and neon. It is where Chaweng's nights end.

  • Green Mango Club: the island's best-known club, open-air on several levels with two dance floors, playing mainstream house, hip-hop and chart remixes. It opens nightly at about 21:00 and closes at about 04:00, depending on its licence. Before 23:00 it is mostly empty; the floor fills from about 00:30. Entry is usually free on normal nights.
  • Sound Club and the soi bars: smaller clubs and open-fronted bars line the rest of the lane, some with event nights and guest DJs. Expect touts with menus at the entrance to each.
  • Drinks: cocktails cost about 200–350 THB and beers about 120–200 THB in the clubs, two to three times the 7-Eleven price.
  • Door rules: you must be 20 or over to drink, and the clubs check. Carry a passport copy or a photo of it. Wear a shirt and shoes; bare chests and swimwear are turned away.

Soi Reggae, a separate lane off the beach road, has long been home to Reggae Pub, a large two-floor venue with live music from the evening. Its hours have varied by season in recent years, so check before you go. [check]

ARKbar and the beach bars

ARKbar Beach Club, in the middle of Chaweng Beach, is the centre of the beach scene. It opens daily from about 10:00 to 02:00 and runs a free fire show and DJs on the sand every night from about 20:00 to 24:00. In 2026 it lists pool parties on Wednesday and Friday from 14:00 to 19:00; some other listings say there is no fixed weekly schedule, so check its own channels on the day. Walk-in entry is free, a sunbed carries a minimum spend (about 300 THB), and drinks cost about 150–300 THB. After about 21:00 the beach party is adults only.

Elephant Beach Club, also on central Chaweng Beach, runs fire shows most nights and DJ nights on Saturday until about 03:00. Smaller beach bars along the sand put out beanbags and candles after sunset and are the cheapest seats with a sea view.

Good to know: the north-east monsoon brings rain and big waves to Chaweng from late October to December. Fire shows and beach parties move back from the water or are cancelled on wet nights, and the sea has red flags. Never swim after drinking.

Live music

Bar Solo, on Chaweng Beach Road, has live cover bands most nights and is the easiest place to start an evening before the clubs, with drinks at about 120–250 THB. Several beach-road bars hire Thai bands playing rock, pop and reggae covers from about 21:00. For a full live-band pub night, Lamai's Shamrock Irish Pub, 12 km south, has a show band every night; see Lamai nightlife.

Cabaret

Paris Follies Cabaret, under the Eiffel Tower sign at 166/92 Chaweng Beach Road, between the main bar area and the beach, is open daily from about 19:00 to midnight. Shows of about an hour of lip-sync, costume and comedy run through the evening, and the entry policy is to buy a drink rather than pay a ticket. Ticket bundles with a drink are also sold online. It is adult entertainment and photography rules apply inside; tipping performers for photos afterwards is expected. Carry ID.

Starz Cabaret, once Chaweng's other big show, closed in November 2021 and has not reopened, although old guides still list it.

Beach clubs

CLUB SEEN Koh Samui, the beach club at Avani Chaweng, relaunched for the 2025–26 season with a day-to-night format: SEEN Eatery for food and UNSEEN Club Room, a smaller after-dark space. In 2025 its weekly pattern was a Friday party, a Saturday pool party and a Sunday brunch, and it hosted the island's biggest one-off events, such as the Zamna "On The Beach" festival on 21 February 2026 and O Beach Ibiza Sundays in January 2026. No 2027 Zamna date has been announced. Cabanas carry minimum spends (from about 5,000 THB per group in 2025). The north-coast beach clubs at Bang Rak and Plai Laem are 15–20 minutes away. Muay Thai stadiums

StadiumNightsTimesTickets (THB)
Phetchbuncha Stadium, Chaweng Yai Soi 13Mon, Wed, SatFrom about 21:001,500 standard · 2,000 ringside · 2,500 VIP
Samui International Muay Thai StadiumTue, Fri, SunGates 20:00, first fight about 21:30, ends about midnight1,500 stadium · 2,000 ringside · 2,500 VIP · 3,000 VIP premium

The stadiums are about 400 m apart, so whichever night you are in Chaweng except Thursday there is a card. A night has about six bouts, from young local fighters to the main event, and finishes around midnight, which leaves time for the clubs afterwards. Phetchbuncha is air-conditioned; Samui International relies on fans. Buy at the box office or book reserved Muay Thai tickets with us, never from street touts. Seats, children and what happens on the night: Muay Thai fight nights on Koh Samui.

Late food

  • Chaweng Walking Street: Thursday to Saturday by Chaweng Lake, opposite Central Samui, from about 16:00–17:00 to 22:00–23:00. Grills, noodles, desserts and shakes. See Koh Samui walking streets.
  • Si Khao Night Market: daily 17:00–23:00, just off Chaweng Beach Road.
  • Food Village: across the road from Chaweng Lake, open until about midnight.
  • Central Samui: the mall's food court and restaurants are open until about 22:00. See shopping on Koh Samui.
  • After midnight: 7-Eleven toasties, noodle carts along the beach road and the odd 24-hour burger counter. No alcohol is sold in shops after 24:00.

A typical big night (two cocktails at a beach bar, four drinks in the clubs, street food and a ride home) comes to about 1,500–2,000 THB per person; add a fight ticket and it is 3,000–4,000. Prices rise 10–20 % from mid-December to February. Budget tips: Koh Samui on a budget.

Scams and safety

  • Touts: on Soi Green Mango and the beach road, touts sell "free entry" deals, cheap fight tickets and party-boat seats. Fight tickets from touts are sometimes for the wrong night or the cheapest seats at a mark-up.
  • Bar bills: check the bill line by line in busy bars. Drinks you didn't order and unannounced service charges are the commonest trick. Paying per round avoids it.
  • Drink spiking: the UK Foreign Office warns of spiking and sexual assault in island party areas. Watch your drink being made and never leave it.
  • Jet-ski "damage": renting a jet ski on Chaweng Beach after a late night is a common way to get a damage claim the next day. Photograph the craft first, or skip it.
  • Vapes and drugs: vapes are illegal in Thailand, including for tourists. Buying cannabis needs a prescription and smoking in public can bring a fine of up to 25,000 THB. Police run checks in Chaweng. Full detail: drugs and alcohol law.
  • The sea: don't swim at night; Chaweng has rip currents, especially from October to December. See beach safety.
  • Help: Tourist Police 1155 · Police 191 · Ambulance 1669. See the Tourist Police on Samui and common scams.

Getting home after midnight

  • Walk: staying within 10 minutes' walk of Soi Green Mango is the simplest plan for a big night.
  • Grab: works well in Chaweng; expect 5–20 minutes' wait and surge prices after 02:00 and in rain.
  • Taxis: red-and-yellow taxis wait on the beach road. They don't use meters, so agree the fare before you get in; late-night fares are 20–30 % higher.
  • Songthaews: the shared pick-ups mostly stop by 20:00–22:00, so they are no help after the clubs.
  • Scooters: never ride after drinking. Police checkpoints are common on the ring road at night, and travel insurance won't pay for a drink-riding crash.

More: getting around Koh Samui.

Where to stay for Chaweng nights

Central Chaweng, between Soi Green Mango and the Central Samui area, puts you within walking distance of everything but also within earshot of the clubs until 04:00. North Chaweng is quieter with a better beach, 10–15 minutes' walk from the action; Chaweng Noi, south over the headland, is quiet and a 5-minute ride away. If you want nightlife only once or twice, Bophut and Fisherman's Village are 15 minutes away and much quieter. Compare: our Chaweng guide, Chaweng vs Lamai and where to stay on Koh Samui.

Beyond Chaweng: party nights and the day after

For the island's biggest party, cross to Koh Phangan: our shared Full Moon Party speedboat picks up from Chaweng hotels and costs 1,400 THB return (the next parties are Tuesday 24 November, Thursday 24 December and New Year's Eve 2026; the New Year's Eve boat is 1,800 THB). Party entry, about 200 THB, is paid at the beach; we don't sell it. Dates: Full Moon Party dates. Everything else that runs after dark: Koh Samui parties.

The morning after, keep it gentle. The Pig Island speedboat tour (1,450 THB adult) runs every day of the year from Thong Krut, and Ang Thong Marine Park reopens on 16 December after its annual closure (from 1 November); the Ang Thong speedboat tour (1,800 THB) is best booked for two days after a big night, not the morning after. Hotel pickup is included from most areas of Koh Samui.
